en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Suleyman Bin Khalid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was saying regarding the free man who died, and for him was a mother who was a slave, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She should be bought from the wealth of her son, then emancipated (liberated), then she would inherit it (the remainder)’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan from ibn Muskan from Sulayman ibn Khalid who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

about the case of a free man who dies and leaves behind his mother who is owned by someone, Amir al-Mu’minin would say, ‘She is bought with the legacy of her son, then is set free and made to inherit her son.’”
